reason: Adds a new opt-in settings field with sensible defaults and changes the default collapsed state of BagPart/FlowPart contained-item widgets in the editor UI, which is a low-risk but user-visible behavioral change (previously nested Inline bags were always collapsed by default, now controlled by a setting defaulting to expanded).
